comments.author: Daedalus
comments.body_html:
Just a personal gripe that I fixed by modifying the mod myself:

The HK11E REQUIRES a foregrip, even when you’re just using G3 mags in it. And only the Zenit RK-1 tactical foregrip on B-25U mount or the bipod can be mounted, even when using the non-obstructive 20/30 round mags. So I went ahead and just set all the normal vertical foregrips to be conflicting items for the 100 round drum instead, and made the foregrip optional. It’ll look jank if you use the drum without the normal foregrip, but who would use it without a foregrip xd?

I assume there’s a way to require a foregrip when the drum mag is installed, but still an improvement imo
